notes: Adds a scalable destination-map library to Maps & Routes. Zermatt now has three built-in schematic traveler maps: Essential Route, Dinner, and Free E-Bus. Other trip destinations have reserved dropdowns ready for future map sets. Daily Operations adds an Open Today’s Zermatt Maps button for Oct. 2–4 and a preview button on Oct. 1, while the Zermatt map group includes a direct Back to Today link. No protected booking values are exposed.
name: TEE v3.5.18 — Destination Map Library
